effects.label: Freeze
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns are paused.The recipient will take 75% damage from incoming attacks.

effects.label: Move SPD Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Movement Speed by the indicated amount.

levels.text:
Selects 1 enemy up to 14m away. Creates a 7m radius zone around the target, ticking 4 times. Damages the 8 enemies with the lowest HP% in the zone every tick, dealing 40 damage. Each hit casts a [50% Move SPD Down] debuff on the targets in the zone every tick, lasting 6s. 
The first hit casts a [Freeze] debuff on the 8 enemies with the lowest HP%, lasting 2s. Frozen targets cannot move or use Skills, take reduced damage from attacks (75%), and their Skill Cooldowns will be stopped.
Accuracy required for: Move SPD Down, Freeze

bio: The Cold Archive is a precious annex of the great libraries of the Academy, and Desmara is its chief. She holds countless ancient tomes and artifacts preserved in the magic of her Archive. And by her own magic, of course – the archive prevents decay, but intruders? Desmara handles those herself.
